'''Territory Administration''' was one of the divisions headed by a [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The division worked with the other divisions to shape the Authority's general policies into a business plan administered by territory. Territory Administration was broken down into a strict structure; twenty-nine [[Territory|territories]] controlled by a [[Territorial Administrator]], broken down into [[region]]s headed by a [[Regional Director]], subdivided into [[zone]]s run by a [[Zone Director]], and finally into individual [[Market (Corporate Sector Authority)|markets]] run by [[Supervisor (Corporate Sector Authority)|Supervisors]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Tanna Odann]] held the post of Viceprex of Territory Administration in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="J10" />
